description_expanded: Overview5.0(4 reviews)SEACREST BEACH – Palms By The Sea New Luxury Home | Rooftop Deck | Sleeps 14 DESCRIPTION Palms By The Sea is a beautifully designed 4-bedroom, 4-bathroom luxury retreat in the heart of Seacrest Beach. This custom home features stylish interiors, spacious living area, and a show-stopping rooftop deck perfect for sunset cocktails and family gatherings. OUTDOOR LIVING & BEACH ACCESS Unwind on the rooftop deck, complete with an outdoor kitchen and dining area, or take a short stroll to the community’s famous 12,000 square foot pool or visit our private beach access. HOME FEATURES ✔ 4 bedrooms | 4 bathrooms | Sleeps 14 ✔ Expansive rooftop deck ✔ Outdoor kitchen and dining area on rooftop ✔ Spacious living area with coastal decor ✔ Gourmet kitchen with quartz countertops and premium appliances ✔ Smart TVs, WiFi ✔ Pet friendly (additional pet fee applies) DINING & ENTERTAINMENT ✔ Easy access to variety of nearby shops, restaurants, and entertainment options WHY STAY HERE? ✔ Stylish, spacious, and ideal for families or small groups ✔ Rooftop sunsets ✔ Central location with easy beach access SLEEPING ACCOMMODATIONS ✔ 2 Master King bedrooms ✔ 1 Queen bedroom ✔ Second floor bunk room, two twin beds over full Seacrest Beach, Florida, is a picturesque coastal community along the stunning Emerald Coast. Nestled between the popular destinations of Rosemary Beach and Alys Beach, it offers a peaceful retreat with easy access to vibrant attractions and natural beauty. THE NEIGHBORHOOD Known for its welcoming charm, Seacrest Beach features cobblestone streets, cozy cottages, and a lively village center filled with unique shops, cafes, and seafood spots. Outdoor enthusiasts can explore scenic trails, nearby nature preserves, or enjoy events like farmers markets and art festivals year-round. Palms By The Sea offers the perfect blend of luxury, location, and laid-back 30A charm. Your unforgettable beach getaway starts here.Show less
